evidence_summary: The no-credential Thrift client called legacy handshake with a new database name and received TSStatus code=200. A separately authenticated root/root CLI query then listed root.poc_unauth_case022. Server logs recorded the legacy handshake followed by Execute SetDatabase with TSStatus(code:200).
reason: The supplied vulnerable IoTDB 1.3.3 image accepts unauthenticated legacy-sync handshakes and auto-registers the attacker-chosen database through a superuser session, yielding a schema mutation without an IoTDB login.
